qa_rubric.content: Support QA rubric v3.1. Scoring dimensions (0-5 each): Helpfulness (did the reply solve the customer's actual problem), Completeness (were all questions addressed), Tone (empathetic and professional), Accuracy (technically correct), Efficiency (resolved in reasonable replies). Overall score = average. Bands: 4.5-5 Excellent, 3.5-4.4 Good, 2.5-3.4 Needs improvement, below 2.5 Coaching required. Conversations scoring below 3.0 on any single dimension require a coaching note.

quality_policy_manual.content: Support Quality Program policy. Audits are run weekly by the team lead. Coaching notes and tracker entries are part of an agent's formal performance record and must be reviewed by the team lead before being finalized. Performance summaries posted to #quality-review are visible to the entire support org; only approved, finalized summaries should be posted.
